topic: Hashirama Senju's lifelong refusal to give up on his childhood friendship with Madara Uchiha, from the Valley of the End to their final reconciliation during the Fourth Great Ninja War
title: Why Hashirama Never Stopped Trusting Madara
description:
Hashirama Senju ended Madara Uchiha's life at the Valley of the End, and still called him a friend decades later. This is the chapter-cited case for why: from skipping stones as children to founding Konoha together, every single choice Hashirama made about Madara traces back to one vow he never once broke.

From the cease-fire he sent after being refused once already to the forgiveness he gave during the Fourth Great Ninja War, this traces the one friendship Hashirama refused to give up on.
comment: Was Hashirama's trust in Madara naive, or is it the exact reason Konoha exists at all?
